g1.label: 1. Stereotypes are ___
g1.why: The text says stereotypes are simplified ideas about a group of people.

g2.label: 2. Stereotypes contain a ___ of truth
g2.why: The text uses the phrase ‘a grain of truth’ to describe stereotypes.

g3.label: 3. Children pick up stereotypes from ___
g3.why: The text says children often pick up stereotypes from their families.

g4.label: 4. Indigenous peoples portrayed as ___
g4.why: The text says indigenous peoples are sometimes portrayed only as figures from the past, like ancestors.

g5.label: 5. Stereotypes can lead to ___
g5.why: The text says stereotypes in schools can lead to bullying.

g6.label: 6. Applicants with foreign names got ___ interviews
g6.why: The text says research showed applicants with foreign-sounding names received fewer interviews.

g7.label: 7. One way to challenge stereotypes is ___
g7.why: The text says one way to challenge stereotypes is to travel and meet people directly.

g8.label: 8. Exchange programmes let young people ___
g8.why: The text says exchange programmes let young people experience other cultures directly.

g1.label: 1. Stereotypes ___ by films and TV
g1.why: ‘Stereotypes’ is plural, so the passive uses ‘are often reinforced’.

g2.label: 2. Cultural awareness ___ right now
g2.why: ‘Right now’ signals an action in progress, so the present continuous passive is used.

g3.label: 3. Students ___ last year
g3.why: ‘Last year’ is a specific past time, so the simple past passive ‘were bullied’ is used.

g4.label: 4. People ___ based on stereotypes alone
g4.why: ‘Should’ + passive expresses a recommendation about how people ought to be treated.

g5.label: 5. The exchange programme ___ in 2023
g5.why: ‘In 2023’ is a specific past time, so the simple past passive ‘was organised’ is used.

g6.label: 6. False assumptions ___ over decades
g6.why: ‘Over the past decades’ signals a duration up to now, so the present perfect passive is used.

g7.label: 7. New laws ___ right now
g7.why: ‘Right now’ signals an action in progress, so the present continuous passive is used.

g8.label: 8. Applicants ___ because of bias
g8.why: ‘Applicants’ is plural, so the passive uses ‘are sometimes rejected’.

g1.label: 1. If the school ___ a course...
g1.why: Type III conditionals use the past perfect after ‘if’, paired with ‘would have’.

g2.label: 2. ...she ___ that her stereotypes were wrong
g2.why: The Type III result clause uses ‘would have’ + past participle.

g3.label: 3. The company ___ the applicant
g3.why: The Type III result clause uses ‘would (not) have’ + past participle.

g4.label: 4. If the film ___ a balanced picture...
g4.why: Type III conditionals use the past perfect after ‘if’.

g5.label: 5. ...he ___ that his assumptions were wrong
g5.why: The Type III result clause uses ‘would have’ + past participle.

g6.label: 6. The class ___ the problem better
g6.why: The Type III result clause uses ‘would have’ + past participle.

g7.label: 7. If the journalist ___ the facts...
g7.why: Type III conditionals use the past perfect after ‘if’.

g8.label: 8. ...we ___ much more about their cultures
g8.why: The Type III result clause uses ‘would have’ + past participle.
